extracted.name: Sadie’s Buttermilk Biscuits Recipe
extracted.description: My grandmother Sadie’s country fair award-winning buttermilk biscuit recipe was perfected on the northern Canadian prairies and uses lard for flakiness.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).

Whisk flour, baking powder, baking soda, cream of tartar, and salt together in a large bowl; cut in lard using a pastry blender until crumbly. Stir in buttermilk. Turn out mixture onto a floured surface; knead a few times to form a moist dough.
Roll out dough to 1-inch thickness; cut out biscuits with a cookie cutter or round glass. Place biscuits on an ungreased baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until tops are golden, about 12 minutes.
